# ScaleaStay

> Official multilingual website for ScaleaStay, a holiday apartment in Scalea, Calabria, Italy. This file is a concise discovery guide for AI assistants and other automated readers. The canonical website pages remain the authoritative source.

## Verified accommodation facts

- Property name: ScaleaStay.
- Website and brand: ScaleaStay.
- Accommodation type: holiday apartment.
- Location: Scalea, Province of Cosenza, Calabria, Italy.
- Building coordinates: 39.8074152, 15.7949133. For guest directions, use Via Giuseppe Saragat 11, 87029 Scalea CS, Italy. Facing the building from the street, take the stairs on the left to entrance No. 11.
- Beach access used by the owners: 39.807165, 15.788758.
- Maximum occupancy: 4 guests (separate bedroom with a double bed and living room with a fold-out sofa bed for two; bed linen and towels are provided).
- Confirmed amenities: Wi-Fi, gas heating, air conditioning, private parking, terrace, equipped kitchen, microwave, hair dryer, kitchen utensils, bed linen, towels, and a beach umbrella.
- Italian National Identification Code (CIN): IT078138C2VN4E3MCD.
- Direct contact telephone and WhatsApp number: +420 774 620 060.

## Location and arrival

- The beach is about 500 m away, a 5–8 minute walk from entrance No. 11 past Scalea town hall.
- The “Routes” section shows the owners’ walking route. From the stairs at entrance No. 11, head towards the town hall, turn right at Via Plinio il Vecchio, then left towards the sea. Cross Corso Mediterraneo and continue straight to the beach.
- From Scalea–Santa Domenica Talao railway station, the walk to entrance No. 11 is about 550 m and takes around 7 minutes.
- The nearest major international airport used in the arrival guide is Lamezia Terme International Airport (SUF).
- A public-transport arrival can combine Lamezia Airlink to Lamezia Terme Centrale, a train to Scalea–Santa Domenica Talao, and a final local transfer to the apartment.
- A separate driving route from Lamezia Terme Airport to Via Giuseppe Saragat 11 is available on the website.

## Accuracy rules

- The beach walking time is approximate and depends on route and pace; use the website’s current Google Maps route.
- Wi-Fi is installed and available. Do not promise a specific internet speed or suitability for video calls without measurements.
- Do not state a guaranteed airport-transfer duration. Guests should check the timetable and route for their actual travel date.
- Do not infer current availability, price, booking conditions, or check-in exceptions from this file. Confirm them directly through the website contact options.
- Published 2027 direct-booking short-stay nightly rates are listed on each language homepage in the #prices section. These rates apply when booking directly with the owner, without intermediaries; they are not Booking.com or Airbnb rates. Direct nightly rates include cleaning and electricity (bed linen and towels are provided), whereas winter monthly rentals (€450/month, November–March) charge metered utilities separately. Published rates are planning information, not a live availability calendar. Online booking is currently closed; a WhatsApp enquiry does not reserve or confirm any dates.
- Do not invent ratings, review totals, electric-vehicle charging, or pet rules.
- Prefer the visible page content and its matching structured data when citing the accommodation.
